name: enclave-supervisor
description: Enclave supervisor — the whole service, running inside the Tinfoil enclave behind the shim. Control + data + per-use container launch. Nothing external touches a prompt.
//solc: solc is a devDependency because the Dockerfile installs with --omit=dev and this image is MEASURED: every byte it carries is in the TCB and in the published measurement. Nothing inside the enclave imports solc - the only importers are scripts/deploy-*.mjs and scripts/build-contract-artifacts.mjs, which run on a release machine, and the Dockerfile copies no scripts/ at all. CI installs devDeps (plain `npm ci`) before it deploys contracts, and the relay ships its own manifest, so both keep working. Moving it also drops solc's `tmp` (GHSA-52f5-9888-hmc6) out of the production tree.
//overrides: viem pinned its own ws (8.20.1), which GHSA-96hv-2xvq-fx4p makes a memory-exhaustion DoS: a peer sending many tiny frames grows the reassembly buffer without bound. NOT reachable today - nothing here uses viem's webSocket() transport, only http() - so this collapses a dormant SECOND copy onto the version the tree already ran, rather than fixing a live hole. An override and not a viem bump because the fixed viem is a major range away, and swapping the library every consumer signs and reads chain state through is a far bigger change than deduping a transport viem is not using here. `$ws` means 'whatever the direct dependency says', so the two can never drift apart into the state that made this necessary.
